understanding.goal_understanding: Navigate each level’s grid to activate and step onto all goal cells. A goal cell counts as complete only when the carried piece’s shape, color, and rotation exactly match that goal’s requirements; completing all goals advances to the next level, and completing all levels wins.
understanding.mechanics_understanding: Each move changes your position on the grid and consumes stamina. Stepping on modifier tiles changes the carried piece: shape modifiers cycle the piece’s shape, color modifiers cycle its color, and rotation modifiers rotate it 90° clockwise. When the piece’s current attributes match a goal cell’s required shape/color/rotation simultaneously, the goal becomes activated, and you must then step onto that goal cell to complete it. Running out of stamina costs a life; losing all lives ends the game.
